explication: Leantime is a web-based project-management application. Its principal web workflow receives a request, runs it through the HTTP kernel and legacy front controller, dispatches a controller action, and renders a response or template. The README documents broader feature areas—including task management, planning, knowledge management, reporting, and administration—but the sampled source does not establish their individual request routes. Those capabilities are represented without speculative connections. The report service-to-repository call is visible in its excerpt; several other subsystem internals were not sampled.
